skill2: Effect 2: Activates when an ally or self destroys a destructible projectile. Scraps ▲ 1 continuously, up to a maximum of 10.
Effect 3: Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part. Scraps ▲ 5 continuously, up to a maximum of 10.
Effect 4: Activates when an enemy is neutralized. Scraps ▲ 2 continuously, up to a maximum of 10.
burst: Deactivation condition: When the duration ends or when all rounds have been fired.

caveats: ⚑ Magazine count is authored at 1 (the battle-start craft). It feeds TWO live values — skill1's ATK ▲7.5%×mags and the burst weapon's Max Ammo — so any measured second magazine moves both at once.

⚑ Burst swap shot economy: with a 1-round magazine the kit deactivates the swap after a single full-charge shot (~0.4s), leaving ~9.5s of the ATK ▲430.05% window on the base SMG. The override expresses only the 10s hard bound; whether the engine reverts on empty or reloads-and-refires the 1-round swap is unverified and is the largest single uncertainty in this baseline.
⚑ Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲16.36% is gated to a Water-code boss (Wind advantage) and fires once at t=0, so it is inert on the neutral/Fire graded boss.
⚑ Base SMG cadence + reloadFrames come from the datamine (known-unreliable); the swap's cadence is charge-time-driven (0.4s) with no kit-stated pull rate.

override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Scrap/magazine economy: skill2 effect 1 grants 10 Scraps at battle start, which immediately satisfies skill1's craft condition (10 Scraps while <4 magazines) → exactly ONE homemade magazine under scope lock, because the only other Scrap sources (destructible projectiles, destroyed enemy parts, neutralized enemies) have no channel in the sim and the graded boss is partless with a single immortal target. Magazine count drives two live values, both authored at 1: skill1's ATK ▲7.5% × magazines (value 7.5, maxStacks 4 so a measured second magazine is expressible) and the burst weapon's Max Ammunition (1 round). skill2 effect 5's Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲16.36% for 15 sec is applied once at t=0 (the battle-start Scrap gain) under a Water-code boss gate. Burst is a self weapon swap: 0.4s charge, 61% of final ATK per shot, ×250% on full charge, 10s window, plus self ATK ▲430.05% for 10 sec. The Scrap pool itself is not tracked as a resource — it has no consumer beyond the craft condition already resolved above.

flags.reasoning: Stack/currency steady-state, derived not guessed: the kit states start (10 Scraps at battle start, cap 10), the consume (10 Scraps per craft), and the rebuild sources (+1 destructible projectile, +5 part, +2 neutralize). On the partless scope-lock boss with no adds, only the destructible-projectile source could fire and it has no sim channel — so the pre-consume count supports exactly one craft. Cap is 4, so a live boss that throws destructible projectiles could reach 2-4 (ATK 15-30%, maxAmmo 2-4).
flags.recipe: Count homemade-magazine icons / the burst weapon's ammo readout at the first burst in footage of the graded fight. Ammo count IS the magazine count (1:1 by kit text), so one screenshot of the swapped weapon's ammo pins BOTH values at once. If >1, raise atkPct to 7.5×n and maxAmmo to n together — never one without the other.

flags.estimate: 1 full-charge shot at 152.5% of final ATK, then revert to the SMG for the remainder of the 10s window
flags.reasoning: Weapon-swap shot economy is an ALWAYS-⚑ field, and here the ceiling is unusually tight: maxAmmo 1 plus the kit's explicit 'or when all rounds have been fired' deactivation means the swap should last ~0.4-0.5s, not 10s. If the engine instead reloads the 1-round swap weapon (base reloadFrames 81 = 1.35s), it would fire ~5-6 charged shots over the window — a ~5-6x over-credit on the burst bucket. The authored durationSec 10 is the hard bound only and does NOT encode the early exit.
flags.recipe: Count burst-window damage popups in footage: 1 large popup = deactivate-on-empty (correct as authored, assuming the engine reverts on empty); a repeating popup every ~1.75s (1.35s reload + 0.4s charge) = the engine is refilling the swap. Cross-check against the engine's weaponSwap ammo-exhaustion branch before trusting either; if the engine refills, the swap needs an explicit early-termination primitive rather than a durationSec tweak.

flags.reasoning: The kit gives the trigger ('when obtaining Scraps') but the sim has no Scrap-gain event after battle start, so the literal model is a single 15s window. On a live boss that throws destructible projectiles the buff would refresh repeatedly and read as near-permanent — the 15s duration on a recurring trigger is exactly the multiply-risk case, so it is authored as ONE passive instance, not a repeating one.
flags.recipe: Only enactable on an element-advantaged (Water) boss recording: watch the buff icon's uptime across the fight. Continuous uptime → drop durationSec (continuous passive); a single 15s window → keep as authored.

flags.reasoning: Two stacked assumptions: (a) the element cycle places Wind advantaged over Water; (b) the engine's elementDamagePct does NOT already self-gate on advantage. The gate is the conservative side of (b) — if the engine gates internally the block is merely redundant, whereas omitting it would over-credit every non-advantaged fight by 16.36 points in the element bucket.
flags.recipe: Read the advantage table in the engine/data (element cycle) to confirm Wind→Water, and read how elementDamagePct is consumed in the damage path. If elementDamagePct is already advantage-conditional, drop the gate as redundant; if not, keep it. No footage needed — this is a code read.
